name: Berkeley Robotics & AI Conference 2025
description: Join NOVA and our partners for the 1st annual Berkeley Robotics & AI Conference, with panels, keynotes, pitches, and group activities emphasizing the connection between the different corners of the industry.

name: Robotics & AI Roundtable 2025
description: NOVA is hosting an exclusive roundtable for students, academics, operators and policymakers in robotics and AI at Berkeley's Faculty Club.

name: Berkeley Gateway Accelerator's Robotics Mixer & Panel w/ Nova Robotics & AI
description: ​Berkeley Gateway Accelerator (BGA), in partnership with NOVA Robotics & AI Community, Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership Robotics Affinity Group, and UC Berkeley Deep Tech Innovation Lab, is hosting a Robotics Mixer & Panel exploring Two Paths to Robotics Innovation: Hardware-First vs Software-First Design.

name: Berkeley Robotics & AI Conference 2026
description: Join NOVA and our partners for the 2nd annual Berkeley Robotics & AI Conference, with panels, keynotes, pitches, and group activities emphasizing the connection between the different corners of the industry.

name: Berkeley Robotics Community Showcase: Where Generations Meet
description: Berkeley Gateway Accelerator, alongside NOVA members, is bringing together high school innovators, university researchers, and deep tech startup founders for an afternoon showcase celebrating what's being built across the Berkeley robotics ecosystem.

name: NOVA Robotics & AI Community Happy Hour
description: Come join NOVA for a networking happy hour at Southern Pacific Brewing for anyone building, investing in, or working in the physical AI space. Grab a drink and connect with others who are working in the industry!

name: Lab to Launch: Robotics Pitch Night
description: ​Robotics research doesn't stay in the lab anymore. Join us for an evening on what it actually takes to get a robotics idea out of the lab and into the world, and to see the founders doing it right now.

name: Robotics & AI Roundtable 2026
description: Join us for a roundtable where influential people from across robotics and AI discuss their insights on the industry
